skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Draft release notes from a changelog
skills.body: Given a CHANGELOG section, write concise release notes: lead with the headline change, group by area, link issues when present.

rules.name: no-secrets
rules.body: Never print, log, commit, or paste secret values. Refer to secrets by name only.

commands.name: summarize-diff
commands.body: Summarize the current uncommitted diff in three bullets: what changed, why it matters, what to verify.
